EPCC platform · every box is a real table, every arrow a real foreign key (dashed = derived / no direct FK)
Generated from the live schema: 123 tables, information_schema columns + foreign keys + CHECK enums + ProcurementState transitions
«append-only» — no UPDATE/DELETE policy exists; a correction is a NEW row, and the newest row (by sequence / ordinal) is the truth.
Dashed arrow = derived, or a join that is not a foreign key. Every table here is RLS + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, scoped by (project_id, company_id).
heat_ref / lot_ref on material_certificate_bindings and component_material_links are DERIVED from the custody chain — a caller never states them.
